item.title: I built a tool to generate Cornell notes from YouTube videos
item.summary: Hello people, I just released a new tool that would create your cornells notes on any given video on YouTube. I would like to get you some feedback, give me a try on the tool and get honest reviews for me. THanks, Link: https://pelicantools.app/tools/youtube-to-cornell-notes Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49406926 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
